<T> long executeInsertOnPreparedStatement(com.coveros.training.persistence.SqlData<T> sqlData, java.sql.PreparedStatement st) throws java.sql.SQLException {
    sqlData.applyParametersToPreparedStatement(st);
    st.executeUpdate();
    try (java.sql.ResultSet generatedKeys = st.getGeneratedKeys()) {
        long newId;
        if (generatedKeys.next()) {
            newId = generatedKeys.getLong(1);
            assert newId > 0;
        } else {
            throw new com.coveros.training.persistence.SqlRuntimeException((("failed Sql.  Description: " + sqlData.description) + " SQL code: ") + sqlData.preparedStatement);
        }
        return newId;
    }
}
